review: I appreciated the plumber calling when traffic slowed him down; he still arrived inside the revised window.
The tap replacement was neat enough that you can barely tell the fitting was changed.
Our water pump failed on Sunday, but the local service replied promptly and restored it that evening.
The electrician replaced an overheating dimmer with a compatible unit and talked me through the new settings.
Two fans were installed without wobble; the quote included labor, so there was nothing unexpected on the invoice.
The electrician responded to my evening message the next morning and arranged a same-day safety check.
The team removed the paint dust without scratching the newly fitted floor.
I received a photo update while the custom desk was being finished.
The cupboard hinge repair was small but done with the same care as a larger job.
Despite a busy week, the carpenter kept the agreed delivery date for our bookcase.
A technician got the chest freezer cold again, saving a batch of groceries; the service charge was clear.
Good communication and a reliable repair made the appliance service worth recommending.
The delivery driver called from the gate, and the vendor quickly sorted out the access issue.
An extra vegetarian meal was added without fuss; communication was courteous throughout.
One washer was replaced, and the old part was left beside the sink.
The invoice lists a call-out fee and a separate charge for the replacement tap.
The cleaner asked which cupboard shelves were part of the request.
The carpenter took measurements for a shelf that will span the alcove.
A replacement hinge was fitted to the upper cabinet door.
The old door handle was returned to the homeowner.
The dishwasher was disconnected while the hose measurement was taken.
The technician ran a rinse cycle and left the settings unchanged.
An estimate for the dryer motor was emailed later that day.
The caterer asked for the final guest count one day before the event.
I waited all morning for the safety inspection, then received a cancellation text at noon.
Several boxes were moved and one fragile lamp was broken during the clean.
The work was rushed, with visible gaps around the frame.
They did not test the dryer after repair, and it stopped mid-cycle.
The estimate changed after the work began, with little explanation.
Portions were much smaller than listed, with no response to my complaint.
Several meal boxes were open in the bag when the driver arrived.
